h: Nishmas and the Spirit Freed From Bodily Blemishes

p: shall bless Your Name, Hashem our God,
and the spirit of all flesh
shall glorify and exalt Your remembrance, etc."
וְאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קלח, א)
And it is brought in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 138a)
שֶׁזֶּה קָאֵי עַל הַנְּשָׁמָה יְתֵירָה שֶׁל שַׁבָּת
that this refers to the additional soul of Shabbos.
דְּאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ קפג, ב)
it is brought in the holy Zohar (this parashah, 183b)
"And it was on the third day
that Esther clothed herself in royalty":
"And it was on the third day"
when the strength of the body had weakened,
and she stood in spirit without body,
then "Esther clothed herself in royalty," etc.;
she clothed herself in the holy supernal Malchus;
certainly she put on ruach hakodesh, etc.
in the margin of the holy Zohar there, explained
that it is because of the weakness from the fast
that she stood in spirit without body.
But there are many who fast
six days, from Shabbos to Shabbos,
and they are still in the body!
along the lines of what we said
עַל מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר בְּפָרָשַׁת בְּהַעֲלוֹתְךָ (בְּמִדְבַּר י, לג)
on what is said in Parashas Beha'alosecha (Bamidbar 10:33):
"And they journeyed from the mountain of Hashem
traveling before them a three days' journey"
that this refers to the three middos,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג צד, ב)
as it says in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 94b):
כִּי שֵׁשֶׁת יָמִים עָשָׂה ה׳ וְגוֹ׳
and it is not written "in six"
for the six days are the six middos,
corresponding to the seven days of Creation
and corresponding to the seven shepherds.
of which the Avos are the chariot,
and they correspond to the three evil traits,
which take a person out of the world.
And this is why Esther said (Esther 4:16),
"to destroy, to kill and to annihilate,"
שֶׁהוּא בְּוַדַּאי כְּנֶגֶד ג׳ מִדּוֹת רָעוֹת הָאֵלּוּ
which certainly corresponds to these three evil traits
which take a person out of the world,
she said that they should fast three days
for she did not know in which of them
And so it is written, "And it was on the third day":
that is, when she merited to be refined
שֶׁהֵם כְּנֶגֶד ג׳ מִדּוֹת רָעוֹת הָאֵלּוּ
which correspond to these three evil traits;
and then "the strength of the body weakened"
these being the three evil traits,
which are essentially powers of the body;
is also among the cravings of the body.
וְזֶה שֶׁאָמַר בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
And this is what the holy Zohar mentioned above says:
"and she stood in spirit without body,
then Esther clothed herself in royalty"
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁדָּרְשׁוּ גַּם בַּגְּמָרָא (מְגִילָּה יד, ב)
as they expounded also in the Gemara (Megillah 14b);
and it is a spirit from that Holiness on High
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב זֹהַר חֵלֶק ג סא, א)
בַּת מִתְעַטְּרָא בַּאֲבָהָן (זֹהַר חֵלֶק ב רד, א)
"the daughter is crowned with the Avos" (Zohar II 204a);
that is, the Jew merits on Shabbos
the holiness of the three Avos;
הוּא גַּם כֵּן קַיְימָא בְּרוּחָא בְּלָא גּוּפָא
this too is "standing in spirit without body,"
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (שָׁם רה, א)
as it says in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 205a):
and not a day of the body."
שֶׁהֵם שִׁירֵי דָּוִד הַמֶּלֶךְ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
which are the songs of David HaMelech, alav hashalom,
שֶׁהוּא רַבָּן שֶׁל בַּעֲלֵי רוּחַ הַקּוֹדֶשׁ
who is the master of those who possess ruach hakodesh
it is brought in the Mechilta
and in the Midrash Rabbah (Beshalach, Shemos Rabbah 23)
that in the merit of faith
and after the Song, we say:
shall bless Your Name, Hashem our God."
הַיְינוּ מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ רוּחַ חַיִּים
that is, one who has in him a living spirit,
merits the additional soul on Shabbos.
"Shall bless Your Name, Hashem our God"
הוּא עַל פִּי שֶׁאָמְרוּ (פְּסָחִים נ, א)
and this is the meaning of "Your Name, Hashem our God."
הוּא עַל פִּי שֶׁכָּתַב בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב קנו–קנז)
follows what the holy Zohar writes (Zohar II 156–157):
What is "And the advantage of the land is in everything" (Koheles 5:8)?
הַאי כֹּל הוּא רוּחַ לְהַאי גּוּף
This "everything" is a spirit to this body;
about which it says "souls that are in the body"
And this is "and the spirit of all flesh
shall glorify and exalt Your remembrance, etc."
הוּא עַל פִּי הַגְּמָרָא הַנִּזְכָּר לְעֵיל
"And this is My remembrance for every generation"
I am read with alef-dalet, Adnus;
and this is "shall glorify and exalt Your remembrance,"
that which is above the intellect
it is not in the category of "exalted"
relative to what is above it.
And it is as we say
in the zemiros of the holy Ari, of blessed memory:
in which is the life of all";
that is, this middah, the middah of Malchus,
שֶׁהוּא צְרוֹר הַחַיִּים (שְׁמוּאֵל א כה, כט)
which is "the bundle of life (Shmuel I 25:29)
as it is brought in the holy Zohar:
אֶת ה׳ דָּא שַׁבָּת דְּמַעֲלֵי שַׁבְּתָא
"'Es Hashem' — this is the eve of Shabbos";
"es" Hashem, attached to the Name Havayah,
we ask that its strength increase
and that it ascend to the head,
up to the middah of Keser Elyon;
And this is the meaning of
that the Name Adnus be exalted
up to the middah of Atika,
